title: Patch Notes: Aura Overhaul
scope: Verbatim Lumberjack section from official HTML; remaining page omitted
source:
Lumberjack

Lumberjack's aura's effects of increasing chopping chances has been folded directly into your hatchets! Different hatchet tiers will improve your chance of chopping wood:

  • Mithril to Rune: +5%
  • Orikalkum to Bane: +10%
  • Imcando & higher: +15%

This is further improved by your Woodcutting skill level, meaning that "over-leveling" trees will feel more powerful! An example of this would be chopping a yew tree with a Necronium hatchet (both level 70). At level 70, you are now 5% more likely to chop wood, increasing to 6% at level 110.
